platforms.name: WMUA 91.1 UMass Music Communications and Archival Music Submission Route
platforms.country: United States / Amherst, Massachusetts college-radio digital and physical music-submission staff route
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee is stated; physical-media production and shipping costs may apply if a physical route is authorized.
platforms.manualReviewReason: WMUA's current staff page says the Music Communications Director is the contact for artists submitting music and the Archival Music Director manages physical and digital music submissions. The role links are non-plaintext/protected and the station does not publish complete file, link, package or metadata requirements. A human must open only the visible official contact route, confirm the accepted delivery method, select suitable clean audio and metadata, and avoid decoding or guessing contact details.
platforms.notes: The official WMUA homepage and staff page were verified on 2026-07-11. They show active live streams, current station contact details, a 2026 copyright notice and named submission responsibilities. No protected contact was decoded, no inquiry was sent and no music or physical package was supplied.

platforms.name: WRIU 90.3 Rhode Island Genre Music Director Digital and Physical Submission Route
platforms.country: United States / Kingston, Rhode Island college-radio digital and physical genre-department submission route
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee is stated; physical-media production and postage costs apply if the postal route is chosen.
platforms.manualReviewReason: WRIU explicitly accepts digital submissions through the appropriate genre department and physical submissions addressed to the relevant Music Director. The RPM/Electronic, World and Reggae contact links are rendered as protected/non-plaintext email routes. A human must choose one correct department, use only the official visible link, confirm file or download-link expectations, prepare release metadata and clean versions, and avoid duplicate multi-department outreach.
platforms.notes: The official WRIU submissions and Music Directors pages were verified on 2026-07-11. They invite artists, labels and promoters, list dedicated RPM/Electronic, World and Reggae departments and display current July 2026 programming posts. No protected address was decoded, no email was sent and no package was prepared.

platforms.name: WRUW-FM 91.1 Case Western Music Director Pre-Submission Inquiry Route
platforms.country: United States / Cleveland, Ohio college-community radio Music Director inquiry route
platforms.feeAmount: No inquiry or submission fee is stated.
platforms.manualReviewReason: WRUW's current Executive Staff page identifies the Music Director through a protected email link, while the public site does not publish complete unsolicited-music delivery rules. A human must use only the official visible contact link to send a concise asset-free routing inquiry, confirm whether digital or physical submissions are accepted, and wait for explicit instructions before supplying audio, links or files.
platforms.notes: The official WRUW site was verified on 2026-07-11. It lists a current Music Director, public office contact details, active 2026 events and an artist call for Studio-A-Rama 2026. The protected email was not decoded and no inquiry or music asset was sent.

platforms.name: WUNH 91.3 University of New Hampshire Physical Music Director Submission Route
platforms.country: United States / Durham, New Hampshire college-radio physical music-submission route
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee is stated; physical-media production and postal shipping costs apply.
platforms.manualReviewReason: WUNH publishes a physical Music Director mailing route, states that every submission is heard but airplay is not guaranteed, and asks submitters not to request status updates. The same contact page contains an Executive Officer form with a human-verification question and its listed officer data differs from the current 2026-27 board. A human must use the generic Music Director postal address, verify package contents and current release eligibility, and must not automate or bypass the form challenge.
platforms.notes: The official WUNH contact and executive pages were verified on 2026-07-11. The site publishes the generic Music Director mailing address, a current 2026-27 board with a Music Director and Assistant Music Director, active streams/schedules and a 2026 copyright notice. No form was submitted, no challenge was handled and no physical package was prepared.

platforms.name: WVKR 91.3 Vassar Music Director and Genre Email or Promotional CD Submission Route
platforms.country: United States / Poughkeepsie, New York independent college-radio digital and physical submission route
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee is stated; promotional-CD production and postal shipping costs apply if the physical route is selected.
platforms.manualReviewReason: WVKR publishes a direct Music Director email, genre-specific contacts including World Music, and a promotional-CD postal route. A human must select the single best route, prepare a concise pitch and release information, verify file or link accessibility before email delivery, or prepare a correctly addressed CD package while accepting that submitted CDs cannot be returned.
platforms.notes: The official WVKR submission, contact, staff and homepage pages were verified on 2026-07-11. They publish wvkrmd@vassar.edu, multiple genre contacts, a physical mailing address, current Music Directors, schedule and playlist links and a May 31, 2026 station update. No email or phone call was made and no CD or music asset was supplied.
